methods.description: Work out the complete expression under a root before taking it.
Evaluate powers and roots before subsequent arithmetic.
Evaluate powers within the radicand in the usual order.
Evaluate roots then multiply/divide from left to right.
Evaluate a root then complete multiplication before addition/subtraction; round calculator results only at the end when requested.
Evaluate complete brackets containing roots before outside multiplication or powering.
Evaluate full numerator/denominator within a root before dividing and taking the root.
Evaluate a cube-root expression before combining terms.
Identify incorrect splitting of a squared bracket or incorrect priority, then show the correct order.
Evaluate separate root terms and grouped fractions before combining exact results.
